questions.question: F6 is entangled with your uncommitted F1-F5 WIP (the reg-dir rename), so it can't be a standalone commit. How should I land it?

options.label: Local commit, no push (Recommended)
options.description: I commit onto the worktree branch bundling your carried F1-F5 WIP + F6 (excluding root scratch files like the PDF/hello.*/output.log). Nothing is pushed/published. You review, reshape, and push from your side.

options.label: Commit + push + draft PR
options.description: Same commit, pushed to origin (gitea) with a draft PR against andesim. This publishes your in-progress F1-F5 WIP to the company remote.

options.label: Leave uncommitted; apply patch
options.description: I leave the worktree as-is and give you the F6 patch to git apply onto your main checkout, so you commit F6 onto andesim yourself alongside your WIP.
